title.zh: FN 速递丨贝莱德比特币 ETF 新玩法拆解，下行保护如何实现？

current_state.zh: BlackRock's proposed PBIT Bitcoin ETF would use three batches of rolling options to limit some downside risk, while investors still absorb the initial loss and give up returns above a cap.
